Privacy policy

What this website handles, what stays on your device, and how to raise a privacy request.

Last updated: 29 September 2026

Who is responsible

TWO BROTHERS HOME is responsible for this storefront. Our contact address is Blessing House, PZ, Store No. 24, Kumasi, Ghana. This notice describes this website’s current functions.

Information you provide

The website does not have customer accounts, enquiry forms, online checkout, or payment collection. It does not ask you to submit your name, telephone number, address, or card details. Search terms, filters, and bag selections are processed in your browser and are not submitted as orders. If you discuss a purchase in person, ask the shop how any transaction information will be used before providing it.

The shopping bag and cookies

The shopping bag is kept in memory only for the current page session. It resets when you reload or close the page. The storefront code does not set advertising cookies, use local storage for customer profiles, or include marketing tracking scripts. Hosting or security services may process technical information as described below.

Hosting and technical data

Cloudflare hosts and delivers this website. When you visit, technical information such as your IP address, requested pages, request time, and browser or device information may be processed to deliver the site, protect it from abuse, and maintain service reliability. Cloudflare may process information outside Ghana. Its handling and retention of service data are described in the Cloudflare privacy policy. This storefront does not maintain a customer database or a separate record of your shopping bag.

External links

Google Maps links open an external service when you choose to follow them. Google then processes data under its own privacy policy. Maps are not embedded on this website.

Your privacy requests

You may ask what personal information is held about you and request correction or other applicable remedies under Ghana’s Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843). Bring your request to our Kumasi store. We may need information to verify your identity before responding. You may also raise a concern with Ghana’s Data Protection Commission.

Changes to this notice

If we introduce checkout, forms, analytics, or other services that collect customer information, we will update this notice to explain those functions. The date above identifies the current version.
